subject.title: [Bug]: /context detail shows ~62k untracked provider/runtime overhead on fresh OpenAI Codex gpt-5.5 session

question: Should `/context detail` grow a provider-aware ledger that distinguishes context-window occupancy, billing/cache counters, Codex native thread state, and unknown residuals for Codex app-server sessions?
rationale: The source can show the generic residual path, but deciding which provider values should drive user-facing labels and compaction/status behavior requires maintainer product intent plus live Codex evidence.

options.title: Keep Open For Ledger Semantics
options.body: Define the bucket model and require live Codex proof before changing context/status/compaction semantics.

options.title: Limit To Copy And Docs
options.body: Keep current accounting behavior and only clarify that the residual is unknown provider/runtime overhead until provider proof exists.

options.title: Treat As Expected Provider Overhead
options.body: Close the issue as expected if maintainers decide Codex totals are already authoritative and no finer OpenClaw ledger is worth maintaining.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Ledger Semantics
recommendation.body: Define the bucket model and require live Codex proof before changing context/status/compaction semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses agent runtime, provider routing, and session/token accounting surfaces where recent history most strongly points to steipete.
